__comment_global: This is an example configuration file. You can safely rename or copy this to data/md_desktop_config.json
name: MitM Medical Devices Desktop

log.__comment_log_level: Valid log_level values: trace, debug, info, warn, error
log.__comment_rotation: Spdlog log rotation settings. Logs are stored in data/logs/YYYY-MM.log

proxy.__comment_proxy: Default proxy server proposal for the UI. Sensitive data like usernames, passwords and the activation state are stored encrypted in data/settings/<user>.enc

wserver.__comment_wserver: Backend API server connection details. Note: Network requests to this host will automatically bypass the proxy.
